name: Docs → Markdown Corpus
tagline: Batch any document set into an AI-queryable Markdown knowledge base.
description: Converts folders of Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF and drawing sets into structured Markdown, building a searchable corpus an assistant can reason over — including a drawings-catalog technique that made an 80-hour job take just over an hour.

page.objective: Turn scattered project documents into a single AI-queryable knowledge base.
page.problem: Knowledge is trapped across dozens of incompatible document formats.
page.solution: A batch converter to structured Markdown, plus a fast path for large drawing sets.

highlights.headline: Batch-converts document folders and drawing sets into AI-queryable Markdown.
points: Mode A converts Excel/Word/PPT/PDF/email to Markdown with a per-file manifest.
Mode B splits construction-drawing PDFs into per-sheet text + image + register.
Read-only on sources; one bad file never aborts the whole batch.
